info.name: Shagan POS API
info.description: Generated from the API Endpoint Inventory doc. Every non-health route currently returns 501 until implemented.

request.description: Shagan-team-only. Protected by X-Internal-Key (INTERNAL_API_KEY), not the regular bearer token - creates Organization + owner User + service_center User in one call. No Branch is created here; use POST /branches (as the owner) afterward, then POST /devices, then POST /internal/accounts/pos to attach a pos-type login to a device.

Shagan-team-only. Protected by X-Internal-Key (INTERNAL_API_KEY). Attaches a new pos-type User to an existing Organization + Device - device_id must already belong to org_id, otherwise returns 404 (not 403 - same not-found-not-forbidden reasoning as branches/staff/devices).

Shagan-team-only. Protected by X-Internal-Key (INTERNAL_API_KEY). Creates a Branch for org_id without needing an authenticated owner session - used right after CreateAccount, before the owner has ever logged in. Same validation/logic as the authenticated POST /branches, just with an explicit org_id instead of one read from the JWT.

Shagan-team-only. Protected by X-Internal-Key (INTERNAL_API_KEY). Registers a Device on branch_id without needing an authenticated owner session - branch_id must already belong to org_id, otherwise returns 404 (not 403 - same not-found-not-forbidden reasoning as the authenticated device/branch endpoints).

Short-lived elevation token for a single approval (void/return/manual-discount) - NOT for a manager's own backoffice sign-in, use VerifyStaffPIN for that. Requires a valid bearer access token (the calling device or owner) - :id is the staff being asked to approve, scoped to the caller's org (and branch, if the caller's own token carries one). permission is the specific permission code this approval is for (e.g. approve_void, approve_return, apply_manual_discount) - the target staff's role must actually grant it, checked via the same Roles/Permissions matrix as GET /roles/:id/permissions. Wrong staff, wrong branch, wrong PIN, and role-lacks-permission all return the same generic 401 (never 404) - a terminal can't enumerate staff IDs, branches, or role grants by probing. On success, returns the Staff record plus a separate 2-minute token (authtoken.StaffClaims) - much shorter than VerifyStaffPIN's 12-hour shift token, since this proves one momentary approval, not a signed-in session. After 5 consecutive wrong PINs, this staff's PIN locks out for 15 minutes (shared with VerifyManagerPIN/VerifyStaffPIN - same underlying PinHash) - further attempts return 429 with an unlock timestamp, even with the correct PIN.

Cashier PIN sign-on at a terminal. Requires a valid bearer access token (the calling device or owner) - :id is the Staff being verified, scoped to the caller's org. If the caller's own token carries a branch_id (a pos-device token), the staff must belong to that same branch, otherwise this returns the same generic 401 as a wrong PIN (never 404) - a terminal can't be used to enumerate staff IDs or which branch they belong to. An owner/service_center token (no branch_id) can verify any staff in the org. On success, returns the Staff record plus a separate, shift-length staff-session token (12h TTL) - distinct from the caller's own device/owner access token. After 5 consecutive wrong PINs, this staff's PIN locks out for 15 minutes (shared with VerifyManagerPIN/VerifyStaffPIN - same underlying PinHash) - further attempts return 429 with an unlock timestamp, even with the correct PIN.

Lists staff at this branch whose role grants the given permission code (query param, required) - not staff with role=manager specifically, since e.g. apply_manual_discount is granted to both super_staff and manager (see the v1 role/permission grant table). Use this to build a picker of who's eligible to approve a specific action before calling VerifyManagerPIN with the same permission code. An unrecognized permission code just returns an empty list, not an error.
Never a hard delete - deactivate only
Writes reconciliation row(s) as a side effect
Cash drawer opened without a sale

Lists products in the caller's org. If the caller's token carries a branch (a pos device), results are restricted to that branch automatically - owner/service_center tokens see every branch. No query params - the scope comes from the token, not something the client can override.

query.description: Required only for an owner/service_center token (no branch on the token). Ignored for a pos-device token, which always uses its own branch.

request.description: Exact-match barcode lookup, scoped to the caller's org and branch - returns the product plus its "images" array (see ListProducts), same presigned-URL/15-minute-TTL reasoning. Barcode is only unique per branch (not per org), so a branch is always required: a pos-device token supplies its own branch automatically; an owner/service_center token must pass ?branch_id= (enable the disabled query param below and set it to a real branch id in that org).

Multipart upload: every product field as a form field, plus "image" (required product photo - attach it yourself, no default file is set). branch_id/category_id must belong to your own org. modifier is optional - leave blank for null.

Multipart upload, scoped to the caller's org (org_id can never be reassigned via this endpoint). Every field is optional - only send what you want to change, remove any row you don't need (an unselected "image" file row causes a Postman bug - EISDIR - so delete it entirely rather than leaving it empty). branch_id/category_id, if sent, must belong to your own org. price/discount/tax are validated against the resulting combined state (existing values fill in for anything not sent), not just the fields in this request. image, if attached, entirely replaces the product's existing photo. modifier can't be cleared back to null via PATCH yet - omitting it just leaves it unchanged.

Multipart upload: name, price, expires_at (RFC3339), and items (a JSON-encoded array of {"product_id","qty"} objects) as form fields, plus an optional "image" file - unlike CreateProduct, a combo can be created without one (leave the file field empty to skip it). price must be > 0, expires_at must be in the future, and items must have at least one entry with no duplicate product_id - each product_id must already exist in your org (create products first via CreateProduct).
Read-only - never written directly by a client
Writes a ledger row as a side effect
Idempotent, transactional; also decrements stock + writes ledger
Inline creation from the POS cart
Needed for the edit form's pre-fill / live preview
No table; renders a test payload
Multipart upload: "file" (the QR image) + "provider" (e.g. kbzpay, wavepay).
Read-only; written via mutation hooks, not a public POST
